title: 复刻 <foreach>：IN 子句展开、空集合的非法 SQL 与批量插入
expected_output:
ids             : [1, 2, 3]
foreach IN      : SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE id IN (?,?,?)
bound params    : [1, 2, 3]
in clause ok    : true
empty IN        : SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE id IN ()
empty in ok     : false
batch insert    : INSERT INTO t_user(name, age) VALUES (?, ?), (?, ?)
batch params    : [tom, 20, amy, 30]
custom sep      : (? OR ?)
